purpose: Close the Branch-specific movement/release chain that the historical SA No.1 chronology cannot supply after Tone and Chikuma fought with the carrier force on 3 Feb.
branch_fixed_inputs: Tone and Chikuma were in the 3-Feb first-line carrier screen in the Branch.
The carrier force withdrew west after severe air-group attrition; Hiryu required Truk emergency repair while Shokaku/Zuikaku remained operational.
High-value mobile assets were evacuated from Truk before the 20-21 Feb HAILSTONE-equivalent attack.
Central-Pacific priority remained HIGH through HAILSTONE/CATCHPOLE and explicitly blocked automatic second Indian-Ocean surface reinforcement.

reconstructed_route_band.center: withdraw Marshalls sector -> Truk/western egress; no battle damage to either cruiser is posted
Truk-centered or immediate western approaches while carrier repair/refuel/air-group triage proceeds; not available for Indian Ocean assignment
depart Truk before HAILSTONE risk peak and reach Palau/western-Carolines support axis; exact port-hour intentionally not overfixed
retained in carrier-scout/screen pool; plausible movement within Palau-Davao/western-Philippines support axis, but no dated southbound chain to Lingga

readiness_at_27Feb_03Mar.hull_machinery: OPERATIONAL centered; no Branch damage debit is posted to either cruiser from 3 Feb.
readiness_at_27Feb_03Mar.crew: Initial battle/transit fatigue largely recovered by late Feb, but reconnaissance teams and shipboard aircraft remain high-value mobile-fleet assets.
readiness_at_27Feb_03Mar.fuel: Adequate for assigned mobile-fleet movements via western support nodes; not treated as discretionary fuel for a low-payoff detour.

01Mar_command_effect: Formation/reorganization of the First Mobile Fleet increases the institutional value of keeping first-line scout cruisers with the carrier force. It does not itself move them to Lingga or authorize commerce raiding.
future_gate: They may later move south with the Mobile Fleet for fuel/training concentration; that is a fleet-basing decision and must not be confused with release for a commerce raid.

historical_contrast.Tone: Historically left Truk 1 Feb and reached Lingga 21 Feb, a chain invalidated by the Branch 3-Feb battle.
historical_contrast.Chikuma: Historically completed Kure refit 1 Feb and reached Lingga 13 Feb, also invalidated by the Branch 3-Feb battle.
historical_contrast.lesson: Historical readiness at Lingga on 27 Feb cannot be inherited after the Branch battle.
